messages:
maya: Heads up — main is red after Dependabot bumped httpx. Failing unit in CI: tests/test_http_client.py::test_retry_logic

sam: yep saw the job fail. pytest stacktrace shows a TypeError inside httpcore usage (different call signature).

ci-bot: [automated] Job failed: linux-py3.10 #4234 — https://ci.redwood.example/builds/4234

liam: sounds like a transitive httpcore bump. httpx updated, pulled httpcore 0.17 which changed some async API.

maya: can someone bisect which dep update pulled the change? quick triage needed, our canary depends on this.

sam: reproduce locally with:
```
poetry install
pytest tests/test_http_client.py::test_retry_logic -q
```
The failure reproduces for me with the current lock.

anika: taking this — spinning up a container to run the same matrix. will try pinning httpcore to confirm.

maya: error snippet in case it helps:
```
TypeError: AsyncConnectionPool.__init__() missing 1 required positional argument: 'backends'
  File "/workspace/.venv/lib/python3.10/site-packages/httpx/_client.py", line 602, in _init_pool
```
Looks like constructor signature changed.

liam: quick options: 1) pin httpcore to 0.16.* in pyproject and regen lock, 2) update our wrapper code/tests for new httpcore API, 3) revert the Dependabot PR. I'd prefer (1) short-term.

sam: to pin locally try:
```
poetry add httpcore@^0.16 --dev
poetry lock --no-update
```
That keeps other transitive pins stable while forcing httpcore.

anika: pushed a small branch that pins httpcore and updates poetry.lock: https://git.redwood/ops/pr/289 (branch: fix/pin-httpcore-0.16)
CI retriggering now.

ci-bot: [automated] Rerun started for PR #289 — linux-py3.10, macos-py3.11

maya: nice, thanks anika. if green we can merge and cut a follow-up to track updating to httpcore 0.17 properly.

ci-bot: [automated] All checks passed for PR #289 — merging.

sam: postmortem note: Dependabot bumped httpx without a compatibility check for httpcore API change. Going to add a tiny CI smoke that imports httpcore and calls the pool constructor we use to surface API removals earlier.

liam: thumbs up. created ticket INF-512 to add the smoke test and a short docs note for Dependabot PR reviewers.

maya: resolved for now — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
